64	    |> list_financial_accounts_with_latest_balance()
65	    |> Enum.filter(&(&1.account.account_type == :investment))
66	  end
67	
68	  def get_financial_account!(%Scope{} = scope, id) do
69	    Repo.get_by!(FinancialAccount, id: id, user_id: scope.user.id)
70	  end
71	
72	  def create_financial_account_with_balance(%Scope{} = scope, account_attrs, balance_attrs) do
73	    multi =
74	      Multi.new()
75	      |> Multi.insert(
76	        :financial_account,
77	        FinancialAccount.changeset(%FinancialAccount{}, account_attrs, scope)
78	      )
79	      |> Multi.insert(:balance_snapshot, fn %{financial_account: account} ->
80	        BalanceSnapshot.changeset(
81	          %BalanceSnapshot{},
82	          Map.put(balance_attrs, :financial_account_id, account.id)
83	        )
84	      end)
85	
86	    case Repo.transaction(multi) do
87	      {:ok, %{financial_account: account, balance_snapshot: snapshot}} ->
88	        broadcast(scope, {:created, account})
89	        {:ok, %{account: account, balance_snapshot: snapshot}}
90	
91	      {:error, _operation, changeset, _changes} ->
92	        {:error, changeset}
93	    end
94	  end
95	
96	  def update_financial_account(%Scope{} = scope, %FinancialAccount{} = account, attrs) do
97	    true = account.user_id == scope.user.id
98	
99	    case account |> FinancialAccount.changeset(attrs, scope) |> Repo.update() do
100	      {:ok, updated_account} ->
101	        broadcast(scope, {:updated, updated_account})
102	        {:ok, updated_account}
103	
104	      {:error, changeset} ->
105	        {:error, changeset}
106	    end
107	  end
108	
109	  def delete_financial_account(%Scope{} = scope, %FinancialAccount{} = account) do
110	    true = account.user_id == scope.user.id
111	
112	    case Repo.delete(account) do
113	      {:ok, deleted_account} ->
114	        broadcast(scope, {:deleted, deleted_account})
115	        {:ok, deleted_account}
116	
117	      {:error, changeset} ->
118	        {:error, changeset}
119	    end
120	  end
121	
122	  def change_financial_account(%Scope{} = scope, %FinancialAccount{} = account, attrs \\ %{}) do
123	    true = account.user_id == scope.user.id
124	    FinancialAccount.changeset(account, attrs, scope)
125	  end
126	
127	  def list_balance_snapshots(%Scope{} = scope, %FinancialAccount{} = account) do
128	    true = account.user_id == scope.user.id
129	
130	    BalanceSnapshot
131	    |> where(financial_account_id: ^account.id)
132	    |> order_by([snapshot],
133	      desc: snapshot.recorded_on,
134	      desc: snapshot.inserted_at,
135	      desc: snapshot.id
136	    )
137	    |> Repo.all()
138	  end
139	
140	  @doc "Returns the current user's balance snapshots in the inclusive date range."
141	  def list_balance_history(%Scope{} = scope, %Date{} = start_date, %Date{} = end_date) do
142	    scope
143	    |> scoped_balance_snapshots()
144	    |> where(
145	      [snapshot, _account],
146	      snapshot.recorded_on >= ^start_date and snapshot.recorded_on <= ^end_date
147	    )
148	    |> order_by([snapshot, _account],
149	      asc: snapshot.financial_account_id,
150	      asc: snapshot.recorded_on,
151	      asc: snapshot.inserted_at,
152	      asc: snapshot.id
153	    )
154	    |> Repo.all()
155	  end
156	
157	  @doc "Returns each user's account's latest snapshot before the history window."
158	  def list_balance_history_baseline(%Scope{} = scope, %Date{} = before_date) do
159	    scope
160	    |> scoped_balance_snapshots()
161	    |> where([snapshot, _account], snapshot.recorded_on < ^before_date)
162	    |> latest_balance_query()
163	    |> Repo.all()
164	  end
165	
166	  def record_balance(%Scope{} = scope, %FinancialAccount{} = account, attrs) do
167	    true = account.user_id == scope.user.id
168	
169	    result =
170	      attrs
171	      |> Map.put(:financial_account_id, account.id)
172	      |> then(&BalanceSnapshot.changeset(%BalanceSnapshot{}, &1))
173	      |> Repo.insert()
174	
175	    case result do
176	      {:ok, snapshot} ->
177	        broadcast(scope, {:balance_recorded, snapshot})
178	        {:ok, snapshot}
179	
180	      {:error, changeset} ->
181	        {:error, changeset}
182	    end
183	  end
184	
185	  def change_balance_snapshot(%BalanceSnapshot{} = snapshot, attrs \\ %{}) do
186	    BalanceSnapshot.changeset(snapshot, attrs)
187	  end
188	
189	  defp latest_balance_snapshots(%Scope{} = scope) do
190	    scope
191	    |> scoped_balance_snapshots()
192	    |> latest_balance_query()
193	    |> Repo.all()
194	  end
195	
196	  defp latest_balance_query(query) do
197	    query
198	    |> distinct([snapshot, _account], snapshot.financial_account_id)
199	    |> order_by([snapshot, _account],
200	      asc: snapshot.financial_account_id,
201	      desc: snapshot.recorded_on,
202	      desc: snapshot.inserted_at,
203	      desc: snapshot.id
204	    )
205	  end
206	
207	  defp scoped_balance_snapshots(%Scope{} = scope) do
208	    from(snapshot in BalanceSnapshot,
209	      join: account in FinancialAccount,
210	      on: account.id == snapshot.financial_account_id,
211	      where: account.user_id == ^scope.user.id
212	    )
213	  end
214	
215	  defp topic(scope), do: "user:#{scope.user.id}:financial_accounts"
216	
217	  defp broadcast(scope, message),
218	    do: Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast(ZaimuTomo.PubSub, topic(scope), message)
219	end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.Worker do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  The OCR -> extraction -> verification pipeline for a single document.
4	
5	  `run/1` executes one attempt and returns `{:ok, content} | {:error, reason}`.
6	  It persists a SUCCESS row itself but never persists a failure: the durable
7	  `ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.OCRJob` decides whether and when to record a
8	  failure based on `ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ErrorClassification` and the
9	  attempt number, so retries never multiply failed rows.
10	
11	  Every terminal write (success and failure rows) is serialized per document:
12	  inside its transaction it locks the document row and re-checks the latest
13	  extraction against the expected id from enqueue time, so overlapping
14	  executions cannot append two terminal rows. A changed document rolls back
15	  with `:already_processed`; a deleted one with `:document_deleted`.
16	
17	  The TypeSafe shadow enqueue is fail-open: a changeset-level enqueue failure
18	  commits the extraction with an `enqueue_failed` shadow (the job insert is
19	  savepoint-isolated inside the success transaction), while a raised DB
20	  exception still rolls back the whole terminal write and surfaces to the
21	  durable `OCRJob` for retry.
22	  """
23	
24	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing
25	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.DocumentOCR
26	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContentContext
27	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.TemporaryFile
28	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
29	  alias ZaimuTomo.Langfuse
30	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
31	  alias ZaimuTomo.Review
32	  alias ZaimuTomo.Storage
33	  import Ecto.Query, only: [from: 2]
34	  require Logger
35	
36	  @doc """
37	  Runs one processing attempt for a self-contained command:
38	
39	      %{document: %Document{}, currency_hint: String.t(), supersedes_extraction_id: id | nil}
40	
41	  Returns `{:ok, %ExtractedContent{}}` when a success row was persisted,
42	  `{:error, :already_processed | :document_deleted}` when the terminal write
43	  was superseded or the document is gone, or `{:error, reason}` without
44	  persisting anything so the caller can retry or record a single failure.
45	  """
46	  def run(%{
47	        document: %{object_key: object_key} = document,
48	        currency_hint: currency_hint,
49	        supersedes_extraction_id: expected_extraction_id
50	      }) do
51	    Langfuse.trace_document_processing(document, fn ->
52	      trace_id = Langfuse.current_trace_id()
53	
54	      case TemporaryFile.create(object_key) do
55	        {:ok, temporary_path} ->
56	          try do
57	            with {:ok, ^temporary_path} <- Storage.get_object(object_key, temporary_path),
58	                 {:ok, markdown, raw_llm_response} <- DocumentOCR.process(temporary_path),
59	                 {:ok, extracted_data} <-
60	                   ZaimuTomo.LLMClient.extract_invoice(markdown, currency_hint),
61	                 {:ok, verification} <-
62	                   ZaimuTomo.LLMClient.verify_extraction(markdown, extracted_data) do
63	              persist_and_emit_success(
64	                document,
65	                extracted_data,
66	                raw_llm_response,
67	                verification,
68	                trace_id,
69	                currency_hint,
70	                expected_extraction_id
71	              )
72	            end
73	          after
74	            File.rm(temporary_path)
75	          end
76	
77	        {:error, posix} ->
78	          {:error, {:scratch_unavailable, posix}}
79	      end
80	    end)
81	  end
82	
83	  def persist_and_emit_success(
84	        document,
85	        extracted_data,
86	        raw_llm_response,
87	        verification,
88	        trace_id,
89	        currency_hint,
90	        expected_extraction_id \\ nil
91	      ) do
92	    analysis = %{
93	      "processed_at" => DateTime.utc_now(),
94	      "verification" => verification
95	    }
96	
97	    extraction_params = %{
98	      document_id: document.id,
99	      user_id: document.user_id,
100	      extracted_data: extracted_data,
101	      raw_llm_response: raw_llm_response,
102	      analysis: analysis,
103	      status: "success",
104	      trace_id: trace_id
105	    }
106	
107	    Repo.transaction(fn ->
108	      lock_and_check_latest(document.id, expected_extraction_id)
109	
110	      with {:ok, content} <- ExtractedContentContext.create_extracted_content(extraction_params),
111	           {:ok, _review_decision} <- Review.create_initial_decision(content) do
112	        # The TypeSafe shadow job is inserted in this transaction so a shadow
113	        # run cannot be lost between commit and enqueue.
114	        enqueue_typesafe_shadow(content, currency_hint)
115	        content
116	      else
117	        {:error, changeset} -> Repo.rollback({:persistence_failed, changeset.errors})
118	      end
119	    end)
120	    |> case do
121	      {:ok, content} ->
122	        DocumentProcessing.broadcast_event(:success, document.user_id, %{
123	          document_id: document.id,
124	          extraction_id: content.id,
125	          user_id: document.user_id,
126	          status: :completed,
127	          data: extracted_data,
128	          timestamp: DateTime.utc_now()
129	        })
130	
131	        {:ok, content}
132	
133	      {:error, :already_processed} ->
134	        {:error, :already_processed}
135	
136	      {:error, :document_deleted} ->
137	        {:error, :document_deleted}
138	
139	      {:error, {:persistence_failed, errors}} ->
140	        Logger.error(
141	          "[OCR] Failed to persist successful extraction for document #{document.id}: #{inspect(errors)}"
142	        )
143	
144	        {:error, {:persistence_failed, errors}}
145	    end
146	  end
147	
148	  def persist_and_emit_failure(document, error, expected_extraction_id \\ nil) do
149	    error_details = %{
150	      "type" => error_type(error),
151	      "message" => error_message(error),
152	      "stack_trace" => error_stack_trace(error),
153	      "timestamp" => DateTime.utc_now()
154	    }
155	
156	    # Failed extractions persist an empty extracted-data embed because invoice
157	    # fields are unavailable when processing does not complete.
158	    extraction_params = %{
159	      document_id: document.id,
160	      user_id: document.user_id,
161	      # Empty map - will fail validation as expected
162	      extracted_data: %{},
163	      analysis: %{
164	        "error" => "Extraction failed",
165	        "attempted_at" => DateTime.utc_now()
166	      },
167	      status: "failed",
168	      error_details: error_details
169	    }
170	
171	    Repo.transaction(fn ->
172	      lock_and_check_latest(document.id, expected_extraction_id)
173	
174	      with {:ok, content} <- ExtractedContentContext.create_extracted_content(extraction_params),
175	           {:ok, _review_decision} <- Review.create_failed_decision(content, error) do
176	        content
177	      else
178	        {:error, changeset} -> Repo.rollback({:persistence_failed, changeset.errors})
179	      end
180	    end)
181	    |> case do
182	      {:ok, content} ->
183	        DocumentProcessing.broadcast_event(:failed, document.user_id, %{
184	          document_id: document.id,
185	          extraction_id: content.id,
186	          user_id: document.user_id,
187	          status: :failed,
188	          error: error,
189	          timestamp: DateTime.utc_now()
190	        })
191	
192	        {:ok, content}
193	
194	      {:error, :already_processed} ->
195	        {:error, :already_processed}
196	
197	      {:error, :document_deleted} ->
198	        {:error, :document_deleted}
199	
200	      {:error, {:persistence_failed, errors}} ->
201	        Logger.error(
202	          "[OCR] Failed to persist failed extraction for document #{document.id}: #{inspect(errors)}"
203	        )
204	
205	        {:error, {:persistence_failed, errors}}
206	    end
207	  end
208	
209	  # Serialize one document's terminal write: lock the document row, then
210	  # re-check the latest extraction against the expected id from enqueue time.
211	  # An overlapping run that already appended a row rolls the transaction back
212	  # with :already_processed; a deleted document with :document_deleted.
213	  defp lock_and_check_latest(document_id, expected_extraction_id) do
214	    case Repo.one(from(d in Document, where: d.id == ^document_id, lock: "FOR UPDATE")) do
215	      nil ->
216	        Repo.rollback(:document_deleted)
217	
218	      %Document{} ->
219	        case ExtractedContentContext.get_latest_by_document(document_id) do
220	          nil when is_nil(expected_extraction_id) -> :ok
221	          %{id: ^expected_extraction_id} -> :ok
222	          _newer -> Repo.rollback(:already_processed)
223	        end
224	    end
225	  end
226	
227	  # TypeSafe shadow runs are best-effort: a failed enqueue is recorded on the
228	  # row but never rolls back the invoice extraction. The currency hint is a
229	  # required argument — a missing hint is a caller bug, never a silent skip.
230	  #
231	  # Only ever called from inside the success transaction (the SAVEPOINT below
232	  # requires an open transaction; there is no fallback path). The job insert is
233	  # isolated with raw-SQL savepoints because Oban drops :mode from insert
234	  # options and Ecto nested transactions are not savepoints. Only a changeset
235	  # error is contained here: a raised exception rolls back the whole terminal
236	  # write and surfaces to the durable OCRJob for retry.
237	  defp enqueue_typesafe_shadow(content, currency_hint) when is_binary(currency_hint) do
238	    if ZaimuTomo.TypeSafeClient.enabled?() do
239	      Repo.query!("SAVEPOINT typesafe_enqueue")
240	
241	      case ZaimuTomo.TypeSafeVerification.enqueue(%{
242	             extracted_content_id: content.id,
243	             currency_hint: currency_hint
244	           }) do
245	        {:ok, _job} ->
246	          Repo.query!("RELEASE SAVEPOINT typesafe_enqueue")
247	          :ok
248	
249	        {:error, %Ecto.Changeset{}} ->
250	          Repo.query!("ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT typesafe_enqueue")
251	
252	          Logger.warning("[TypeSafe] Shadow verification enqueue failed class=enqueue_failed",
253	            typesafe_error_class: "enqueue_failed"
254	          )
255	
256	          _result =
257	            ExtractedContentContext.put_typesafe_shadow(content.id, %{
258	              "status" => "verification_failed",
259	              "error" => "enqueue_failed"
260	            })
261	
262	          :ok
263	      end
264	    else
265	      Logger.debug("[TypeSafe] Shadow verification skipped")
266	    end
267	  end
268	
269	  # Error handling helper functions
270	  defp error_type(error) when is_tuple(error),
271	    do: elem(error, 0) |> to_string()
272	
273	  defp error_type(error) when is_atom(error),
274	    do: Atom.to_string(error)
275	
276	  defp error_type(_error),
277	    do: "unknown"
278	
279	  defp error_message({_tag, %{reason: reason}}) when is_binary(reason), do: reason
280	
281	  defp error_message(error) when is_tuple(error) do
282	    val = elem(error, 1)
283	    if is_binary(val), do: val, else: inspect(val)
284	  end
285	
286	  defp error_message(error) when is_atom(error), do: Atom.to_string(error)
287	  defp error_message(error) when is_binary(error), do: error
288	  defp error_message(error), do: inspect(error)
289	
290	  defp error_stack_trace(_error),
291	    do: []
292	end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.Recovery do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Unscoped maintenance recovery for stuck documents: no extraction row and no
4	  live OCR job (e.g. a run that was lost to a crash or a discarded job).
5	
6	  Grouped per user so each run uses the owner's own base currency snapshot,
7	  mirroring the enqueue-time snapshot semantics of `DocumentProcessing.ocr_job/3`.
8	  """
9	
10	  import Ecto.Query
11	
12	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User
13	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing
14	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
15	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
16	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
17	
18	  @type group :: %{user_id: pos_integer(), currency: String.t(), document_ids: [pos_integer()]}
19	
20	  @doc """
21	  Lists stuck documents (no extraction row, no live OCR job), grouped per user
22	  with that user's base currency.
23	
24	  Intentionally unscoped: maintenance commands operate on the complete document
25	  collection (like `ZaimuTomo.Documents.list_document_object_keys/0`).
26	  """
27	  @spec list_stuck() :: [group()]
28	  def list_stuck do
29	    # Correlated NOT EXISTS with a safe text comparison: a malformed live job
30	    # (missing or non-numeric document_id) neither hides every document (as a
31	    # NULL-poisoned NOT IN would) nor raises (as a ::bigint cast would).
32	    from(d in Document,
33	      as: :doc,
34	      join: u in User,
35	      on: u.id == d.user_id,
36	      left_join: ec in ExtractedContent,
37	      on: ec.document_id == d.id,
38	      where: is_nil(ec.id),
39	      where:
40	        not exists(
41	          from(j in DocumentProcessing.live_jobs(),
42	            where: fragment("?->>'document_id' = ?::text", j.args, parent_as(:doc).id),
43	            select: 1
44	          )
45	        ),
46	      order_by: [asc: u.id, asc: d.id],
47	      select: %{user_id: u.id, currency: u.base_currency, document_id: d.id}
48	    )
49	    |> Repo.all()
50	    |> Enum.group_by(& &1.user_id)
51	    |> Enum.sort_by(fn {user_id, _rows} -> user_id end)
52	    |> Enum.map(fn {user_id, rows} ->
53	      %{
54	        user_id: user_id,
55	        currency: hd(rows).currency,
56	        document_ids: Enum.map(rows, & &1.document_id)
57	      }
58	    end)
59	  end
60	
61	  @doc """
62	  Enqueues one fresh OCR job per stuck document and returns the enqueued jobs.
63	
64	  Idempotent through OCRJob uniqueness: when a live job already exists for a
65	  document, Oban reports a conflict and no second job is created.
66	  """
67	  @spec enqueue_stuck([group()]) :: [Oban.Job.t()]
68	  def enqueue_stuck(groups) when is_list(groups) do
69	    Enum.flat_map(groups, fn %{currency: currency, document_ids: document_ids} ->
70	      Enum.flat_map(document_ids, fn document_id ->
71	        %Document{id: document_id}
72	        |> DocumentProcessing.ocr_job(currency, nil)
73	        |> Oban.insert()
74	        |> case do
75	          {:ok, %Oban.Job{conflict?: true}} -> []
76	          {:ok, %Oban.Job{} = job} -> [job]
77	        end
78	      end)
79	    end)
80	  end
81	end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.OCRJob do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Durable OCR -> extraction -> verification run for one document.
4	
5	  Args are a self-contained command resolved at enqueue time: `document_id`,
6	  `currency_hint` (the owner's base currency snapshot) and
7	  `supersedes_extraction_id` (the latest extraction id at enqueue time, or nil).
8	  The job never queries Accounts.
9	
10	  A `{:cancel, reason}` return voids the job: deleted document, already
11	  processed by an earlier attempt after a Lifeline rescue, or a failure whose
12	  failed row could not be recorded. A transient error on a non-final attempt
13	  returns `{:error, ErrorClassification.summarize(reason)}` WITHOUT persisting,
14	  so Oban backs off and retries and no raw provider payload reaches
15	  `oban_jobs.errors`; a permanent error, or a transient error on the final
16	  attempt, persists exactly one failed row and completes.
17	  """
18	  use Oban.Worker,
19	    queue: :documents,
20	    max_attempts: 5,
21	    unique: [
22	      keys: [:document_id],
23	      states: [:available, :scheduled, :executing, :retryable],
24	      period: :infinity
25	    ]
26	
27	  require Logger
28	
29	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.{ErrorClassification, ExtractedContentContext, Worker}
30	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
31	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
32	
33	  @impl Oban.Worker
34	  def timeout(_job), do: :timer.minutes(10)
35	
36	  @impl Oban.Worker
37	  def perform(%Oban.Job{args: %{"document_id" => id, "currency_hint" => hint} = args} = job) do
38	    with {:ok, document} <- fetch_document(id),
39	         :ok <- ensure_not_superseded(document, args) do
40	      %{
41	        document: document,
42	        currency_hint: hint,
43	        supersedes_extraction_id: Map.get(args, "supersedes_extraction_id")
44	      }
45	      |> Worker.run()
46	      |> handle_result(document, job)
47	    end
48	  end
49	
50	  defp fetch_document(id) do
51	    case Repo.get(Document, id) do
52	      %Document{} = document -> {:ok, document}
53	      nil -> {:cancel, :document_deleted}
54	    end
55	  end
56	
57	  # Idempotency after a Lifeline rescue: if a row was appended since this job
58	  # was enqueued, an earlier attempt already finished its work. Cheap early
59	  # exit only — the authoritative re-check runs under the document-row lock
60	  # inside the persist transaction (see Worker.run/1).
61	  defp ensure_not_superseded(document, args) do
62	    expected = Map.get(args, "supersedes_extraction_id")
63	
64	    case ExtractedContentContext.get_latest_by_document(document.id) do
65	      nil when is_nil(expected) -> :ok
66	      %{id: ^expected} -> :ok
67	      _newer -> {:cancel, :already_processed}
68	    end
69	  end
70	
71	  defp handle_result({:ok, _content}, _document, _job), do: :ok
72	
73	  defp handle_result({:error, :already_processed}, _document, _job),
74	    do: {:cancel, :already_processed}
75	
76	  defp handle_result({:error, :document_deleted}, _document, _job),
77	    do: {:cancel, :document_deleted}
78	
79	  defp handle_result({:error, reason}, document, job) do
80	    handle_failure(
81	      ErrorClassification.classify(reason),
82	      final_attempt?(job),
83	      document,
84	      reason,
85	      Map.get(job.args, "supersedes_extraction_id")
86	    )
87	  end
88	
89	  # Transient and not the final attempt: retry without persisting anything.
90	  # Oban keeps only a bounded, body-free summary of the reason.
91	  defp handle_failure(:transient, false, _document, reason, _expected_extraction_id) do
92	    {:error, ErrorClassification.summarize(reason)}
93	  end
94	
95	  # Permanent (any attempt) or transient on the final attempt: record one failure.
96	  defp handle_failure(class, _final?, document, reason, expected_extraction_id) do
97	    record_failure(class, document, reason, expected_extraction_id)
98	  end
99	
100	  defp record_failure(class, document, reason, expected_extraction_id) do
101	    case Worker.persist_and_emit_failure(document, reason, expected_extraction_id) do
102	      {:ok, _content} ->
103	        Logger.warning(
104	          "[OCR] Processing failed for document #{document.id} (#{class}): " <>
105	            ErrorClassification.summarize(reason)
106	        )
107	
108	        :ok
109	
110	      {:error, :already_processed} ->
111	        {:cancel, :already_processed}
112	
113	      {:error, :document_deleted} ->
114	        {:cancel, :document_deleted}
115	
116	      {:error, {:persistence_failed, errors}} ->
117	        handle_persist_failure(document, errors)
118	    end
119	  end
120	
121	  # The failed row could not be written and the run is not superseded: void the
122	  # job with an actionable audit trail instead of completing silently, so stuck
123	  # detection can surface the document (no row, no live job). The reason kept
124	  # in oban_jobs.errors is a short summary of the changeset error keys, never
125	  # provider payloads.
126	  defp handle_persist_failure(document, errors) do
127	    summary = changeset_error_summary(errors)
128	
129	    Logger.error("[OCR] Could not record failure for document #{document.id}: #{summary}")
130	
131	    {:cancel, {:failure_not_recorded, summary}}
132	  end
133	
134	  defp changeset_error_summary(errors) do
135	    errors |> Keyword.keys() |> Enum.sort() |> Enum.join(",")
136	  end
137	
138	  defp final_attempt?(%Oban.Job{attempt: attempt, max_attempts: max}), do: attempt >= max
139	end
140

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContentContext do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Context for managing extracted content from OCR/LLM processing.
4	  """
5	
6	  import Ecto.Query
7	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
8	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
9	
10	  @doc """
11	  Creates a new extracted content record.
12	
13	  ## Parameters
14	    - attrs: Map containing extracted content data
15	
16	  ## Returns
17	    - {:ok, %ExtractedContent{}} on success
18	    - {:error, changeset} on validation error
19	  """
20	  def create_extracted_content(attrs) do
21	    %ExtractedContent{}
22	    |> ExtractedContent.changeset(attrs)
23	    |> Repo.insert()
24	  end
25	
26	  @doc """
27	  Gets extracted content by ID.
28	
29	  ## Parameters
30	    - extraction_id: ID of the extracted content record
31	
32	  ## Returns
33	    - %ExtractedContent{} or nil
34	  """
35	  def get_by_id(extraction_id) do
36	    query =
37	      from ec in ExtractedContent,
38	        where: ec.id == ^extraction_id,
39	        limit: 1
40	
41	    Repo.one(query)
42	  end
43	
44	  @doc """
45	  Persists a TypeSafe shadow result without replacing authoritative verification.
46	  """
47	  @spec put_typesafe_shadow(pos_integer(), map()) ::
48	          {:ok, ExtractedContent.t()} | {:error, term()}
49	  def put_typesafe_shadow(extraction_id, shadow) when is_map(shadow) do
50	    case get_by_id(extraction_id) do
51	      %ExtractedContent{} = content ->
52	        analysis = content.analysis || %{}
53	        verification = Map.get(analysis, "verification", %{})
54	
55	        updated_analysis =
56	          Map.put(analysis, "verification", Map.put(verification, "typesafe_shadow", shadow))
57	
58	        content
59	        |> Ecto.Changeset.change(analysis: updated_analysis)
60	        |> Repo.update()
61	
62	      nil ->
63	        {:error, :extracted_content_not_found}
64	    end
65	  end
66	
67	  @doc """
68	  Gets the latest extraction for a document.
69	
70	  ## Parameters
71	    - document_id: ID of the document
72	
73	  ## Returns
74	    - %ExtractedContent{} or nil
75	  """
76	  def get_latest_by_document(document_id) do
77	    query =
78	      from ec in ExtractedContent,
79	        where: ec.document_id == ^document_id,
80	        order_by: [desc: :inserted_at, desc: :id],
81	        limit: 1
82	
83	    Repo.one(query)
84	  end
85	
86	  def get_structured_data(content) when is_map(content) do
87	    # extracted_data is already a struct, just return it
88	    {:ok, content.extracted_data}
89	  end
90	
91	  def get_response_data(content) do
92	    # Convert struct to map for API responses
93	    Map.from_struct(content.extracted_data)
94	  end
95	
96	  def get_analysis(content) do
97	    content.analysis || %{}
98	  end
99	
100	  # Combined response with data and analysis
101	  def get_full_response(content) do
102	    %{
103	      "data" => get_response_data(content),
104	      "analysis" => get_analysis(content),
105	      "status" => content.status,
106	      "extracted_at" => content.inserted_at
107	    }
108	  end
109	
110	  # Get specific fields with type safety
111	  def get_invoice_amount(content) do
112	    content.extracted_data.amount_to_pay_cents
113	  end
114	
115	  def get_invoice_date(content) do
116	    content.extracted_data.invoice_date
117	  end

121	  end

2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Release helpers used by deployment tasks.
4	  """
5	
6	  @app :zaimu_tomo
7

9	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing

12	
13	  def migrate do
14	    load_app()
15	
16	    for repo <- repos() do
17	      {:ok, _, _} = Ecto.Migrator.with_repo(repo, &Ecto.Migrator.run(&1, :up, all: true))
18	    end
19	  end
20	
21	  def rollback(repo, version) do
22	    load_app()
23	    {:ok, _, _} = Ecto.Migrator.with_repo(repo, &Ecto.Migrator.run(&1, :down, to: version))
24	  end
25	
26	  def migrate_to_s3!(source_dir) when is_binary(source_dir) do
27	    start_app()
28	    report_or_raise(Migration.migrate(source_dir), Migration)
29	  end
30	
31	  def migrate_to_s3_from_env! do
32	    System.fetch_env!("SOURCE_DIR")
33	    |> migrate_to_s3!()
34	  end
35	
36	  def backfill_document_fingerprints!(opts \\ []) do
37	    start_app()
38	    report_or_raise(FingerprintBackfill.run(opts), FingerprintBackfill)
39	  end
40	
41	  def backfill_legacy_bookings!(opts \\ []) do
42	    start_app()
43	    report_or_raise(LegacyBookingBackfill.run(opts), LegacyBookingBackfill)
44	  end
45	
46	  def verify_storage! do
47	    start_app()
48	    report_or_raise(Verification.verify(), Verification)
49	  end
50	
51	  def recover_stuck_documents!(opts \\ []) do
52	    start_app()
53	    groups = DocumentProcessing.Recovery.list_stuck()
54	    Enum.each(groups, &print_stuck_group/1)
55	
56	    dispatch_recovery(Keyword.get(opts, :confirm, false), groups)
57	  end
58	
59	  defp dispatch_recovery(true, groups) do
60	    jobs = DocumentProcessing.Recovery.enqueue_stuck(groups)
61	    IO.puts("Enqueued #{length(jobs)} OCR jobs.")
62	    groups
63	  end
64	
65	  defp dispatch_recovery(false, groups) do
66	    count = groups |> Enum.map(&length(&1.document_ids)) |> Enum.sum()
67	    IO.puts("Dry run: #{count} stuck documents — nothing enqueued.")
68	    IO.puts("Re-run with confirm: true (or CONFIRM=true) to enqueue.")
69	    groups
70	  end
71	
72	  defp print_stuck_group(%{user_id: user_id, currency: currency, document_ids: document_ids}) do
73	    IO.puts("user #{user_id} (#{currency}): document ids #{Enum.join(document_ids, ", ")}")
74	  end
75	
76	  defp repos do
77	    Application.fetch_env!(@app, :ecto_repos)
78	  end
79	
80	  defp load_app do
81	    Application.load(@app)
82	  end
83	
84	  defp start_app do
85	    load_app()
86	
87	    # Eval nodes run maintenance only: no queues, no plugins, no leadership, so
88	    # a short-lived node never grabs a job and dies mid-run (leaving it orphaned
89	    # until Lifeline rescues it).
90	    oban = Application.fetch_env!(@app, Oban)
91	
92	    Application.put_env(
93	      @app,
94	      Oban,
95	      Keyword.merge(oban, queues: false, plugins: false, peer: false)
96	    )
97	
98	    case Application.ensure_all_started(@app) do
99	      {:ok, _started} -> :ok
100	      {:error, reason} -> raise "could not start #{@app}: #{inspect(reason)}"
101	    end
102	  end
103	
104	  defp report_or_raise({status, summary}, formatter) do
105	    IO.puts(formatter.format_summary(summary))
106	
107	    case status do
108	      :ok -> summary
109	      :error -> raise "maintenance command failed"
110	    end
111	  end
112	end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  The DocumentProcessing context.
4	
5	  Builds durable OCR job commands that Oban dispatches. The enqueue is atomic
6	  with the document insert (see `ZaimuTomo.Documents.create_document/2`), so an
7	  upload can never exist without its processing job.
8	
9	  Also owns the processing state of a document and the scope-checked retry
10	  entry point for failed or stuck runs.
11	  """
12	
13	  import Ecto.Query
14	
15	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.Scope
16	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
17	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContentContext
18	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.OCRJob
19	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
20	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
21	
22	  @ocr_job_worker "ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.OCRJob"
23	  @live_job_states ~w(available scheduled executing retryable)
24	  @event_kinds [:success, :failed, :retried]
25	
26	  @typedoc """
27	  Processing state of a document:
28	
29	    * `:processing` — a live OCR job exists (queued, scheduled or running)
30	    * `:stuck` — no extraction and no live job (the run was lost)
31	    * `:failed` — the latest extraction failed
32	    * `:extracted` — the latest extraction succeeded
33	  """
34	  @type processing_state :: :processing | :stuck | :failed | :extracted
35	
36	  @doc """
37	  Subscribes the caller to the scope owner's processing events.
38	
39	  Messages are the maps broadcast by `broadcast_event/3`: a run finished
40	  (`:success` / `:failed`) or a retry was enqueued (`:retried`). Topics are per
41	  owner, so a subscriber never receives another user's extracted data.
42	  """
43	  @spec subscribe_events(Scope.t()) :: :ok | {:error, term()}
44	  def subscribe_events(%Scope{user: %{id: user_id}}) do
45	    Enum.find_value(@event_kinds, :ok, fn kind ->
46	      case Phoenix.PubSub.subscribe(ZaimuTomo.PubSub, event_topic(user_id, kind)) do
47	        :ok -> nil
48	        error -> error
49	      end
50	    end)
51	  end
52	
53	  @doc false
54	  @spec broadcast_event(:success | :failed | :retried, integer(), map()) ::
55	          :ok | {:error, term()}
56	  def broadcast_event(kind, user_id, payload) when kind in @event_kinds do
57	    Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast(ZaimuTomo.PubSub, event_topic(user_id, kind), payload)
58	  end
59	
60	  defp event_topic(user_id, kind), do: "user:#{user_id}:document_processing:#{kind}"
61	
62	  @doc """
63	  Builds the OCR job changeset for a document.
64	
65	  The command is self-contained and resolved at enqueue time: the document id,
66	  a queue-time snapshot of the owner's base currency (`currency_hint`), and the
67	  latest extraction id to supersede (or `nil` when there is none). The worker
68	  pattern-matches this command and never queries Accounts.
69	  """
70	  def ocr_job(%Document{} = document, currency_hint, supersedes_extraction_id) do
71	    OCRJob.new(%{
72	      document_id: document.id,
73	      currency_hint: currency_hint,
74	      supersedes_extraction_id: supersedes_extraction_id
75	    })
76	  end
77	
78	  @doc """
79	  Returns the processing state of a document.
80	  """
81	  @spec processing_state(Document.t()) :: processing_state()
82	  def processing_state(%Document{} = document) do
83	    latest = ExtractedContentContext.get_latest_by_document(document.id)
84	    classify_state(live_job?(document.id), latest)
85	  end
86	
87	  @doc """
88	  Returns the processing state of many documents at once.
89	
90	  Same semantics as `processing_state/1`, but resolved with two queries
91	  (live jobs and latest extraction per document) regardless of how many ids are
92	  given. Use it wherever a list of documents needs their current state.
93	  """
94	  @spec processing_states([pos_integer()]) :: %{pos_integer() => processing_state()}
95	  def processing_states([]), do: %{}
96	
97	  def processing_states(document_ids) when is_list(document_ids) do
98	    live_ids =
99	      live_jobs()
100	      |> where(
101	        [j],
102	        fragment("?->>'document_id'", j.args) in ^Enum.map(document_ids, &to_string/1)
103	      )
104	      |> select([j], fragment("?->>'document_id'", j.args))
105	      |> Repo.all()
106	      |> MapSet.new()
107	
108	    latest_statuses =
109	      ExtractedContent
110	      |> where([ec], ec.document_id in ^document_ids)
111	      |> distinct([ec], ec.document_id)
112	      |> order_by([ec], asc: ec.document_id, desc: ec.inserted_at, desc: ec.id)
113	      |> select([ec], {ec.document_id, ec.status})
114	      |> Repo.all()
115	      |> Map.new()
116	
117	    Map.new(document_ids, fn id ->
118	      latest = latest_statuses[id] && %{status: latest_statuses[id]}
119	      {id, classify_state(MapSet.member?(live_ids, to_string(id)), latest)}
120	    end)
121	  end
122	
123	  defp classify_state(true, _latest), do: :processing
124	  defp classify_state(false, nil), do: :stuck
125	  defp classify_state(false, %{status: "failed"}), do: :failed
126	  defp classify_state(false, %{status: "success"}), do: :extracted
127	
128	  @doc """
129	  Retries processing for a document whose latest run failed or stalled.
130	
131	  The document must be a persisted struct obtained through a scoped getter
132	  (e.g. `ZaimuTomo.Documents.get_document!/2`), matching the trust model of
133	  `ZaimuTomo.Documents.update_document/3`.
134	  Scope-checked: a document owned by another user returns `{:error, :not_found}`.
135	  Only `:failed` and `:stuck` are retryable; any other state returns
136	  `{:error, {:not_retryable, state}}`. The enqueue carries the latest extraction
137	  id as `supersedes_extraction_id` (nil when stuck), and failed rows are kept as
138	  history — the new run appends a row. An Oban uniqueness conflict counts as
139	  success: at most one live job can exist per document.
140	  """
141	  @spec retry_document(Scope.t(), Document.t()) ::
142	          {:ok, Oban.Job.t()} | {:error, :not_found | {:not_retryable, processing_state()}}
143	  def retry_document(%Scope{user: %{id: user_id}} = scope, %Document{user_id: user_id} = document) do
144	    latest = ExtractedContentContext.get_latest_by_document(document.id)
145	
146	    case classify_state(live_job?(document.id), latest) do
147	      state when state in [:failed, :stuck] ->
148	        with {:ok, job} <-
149	               document
150	               |> ocr_job(scope.user.base_currency, latest && latest.id)
151	               |> Oban.insert() do
152	          # Lets open Index / hero views pick up the new live run without a reload.
153	          broadcast_event(:retried, user_id, %{document_id: document.id, user_id: user_id})
154	          {:ok, job}
155	        end
156	
157	      state ->
158	        {:error, {:not_retryable, state}}
159	    end
160	  end
161	
162	  def retry_document(%Scope{}, %Document{}), do: {:error, :not_found}
163	
164	  @doc """
165	  Returns true when a live OCR job exists for the document.
166	  """
167	  @spec live_job?(pos_integer()) :: boolean()
168	  def live_job?(document_id) do
169	    # Same safe text comparison as Recovery.list_stuck/0: no ::bigint cast on
170	    # job args, so a malformed job (missing or non-numeric document_id) is
171	    # simply not a match and never raises.
172	    live_jobs()
173	    |> where([j], fragment("?->>'document_id' = ?", j.args, ^to_string(document_id)))
174	    |> limit(1)
175	    |> Repo.one()
176	    |> case do
177	      %Oban.Job{} -> true
178	      nil -> false
179	    end
180	  end
181	
182	  @doc """
183	  Base query over live OCR jobs (worker + states that still count as in-flight).
184	  """
185	  @spec live_jobs() :: Ecto.Query.t()
186	  def live_jobs do
187	    from j in Oban.Job,
188	      where: j.worker == @ocr_job_worker,
189	      where: j.state in @live_job_states
190	  end
191	end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing do
  @moduledoc """
  The DocumentProcessing context.

  Builds durable OCR job commands that Oban dispatches. The enqueue is atomic
  with the document insert (see `ZaimuTomo.Documents.create_document/2`), so an
  upload can never exist without its processing job.

  Also owns the processing state of a document and the scope-checked retry
  entry point for failed or stuck runs.
  """

  import Ecto.Query

  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.Scope
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContentContext
  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.OCRJob
  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo

  @ocr_job_worker "ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.OCRJob"
  @live_job_states ~w(available scheduled executing retryable)
  @event_kinds [:success, :failed, :retried]

  @typedoc """
  Processing state of a document:

    * `:processing` — a live OCR job exists (queued, scheduled or running)
    * `:stuck` — no extraction and no live job (the run was lost)
    * `:failed` — the latest extraction failed
    * `:extracted` — the latest extraction succeeded
  """
  @type processing_state :: :processing | :stuck | :failed | :extracted

  @doc """
  Subscribes the caller to the scope owner's processing events.

  Messages are the maps broadcast by `broadcast_event/3`: a run finished
  (`:success` / `:failed`) or a retry was enqueued (`:retried`). Topics are per
  owner, so a subscriber never receives another user's extracted data.
  """
  @spec subscribe_events(Scope.t()) :: :ok | {:error, term()}
  def subscribe_events(%Scope{user: %{id: user_id}}) do
    Enum.find_value(@event_kinds, :ok, fn kind ->
      case Phoenix.PubSub.subscribe(ZaimuTomo.PubSub, event_topic(user_id, kind)) do
        :ok -> nil
        error -> error
      end
    end)
  end

  @doc false
  @spec broadcast_event(:success | :failed | :retried, integer(), map()) ::
          :ok | {:error, term()}
  def broadcast_event(kind, user_id, payload) when kind in @event_kinds do
    Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast(ZaimuTomo.PubSub, event_topic(user_id, kind), payload)
  end

  defp event_topic(user_id, kind), do: "user:#{user_id}:document_processing:#{kind}"

  @doc """
  Builds the OCR job changeset for a document.

  The command is self-contained and resolved at enqueue time: the document id,
  a queue-time snapshot of the owner's base currency (`currency_hint`), and the
  latest extraction id to supersede (or `nil` when there is none). The worker
  pattern-matches this command and never queries Accounts.
  """
  def ocr_job(%Document{} = document, currency_hint, supersedes_extraction_id) do
    OCRJob.new(%{
      document_id: document.id,
      currency_hint: currency_hint,
      supersedes_extraction_id: supersedes_extraction_id
    })
  end

  @doc """
  Returns the processing state of a document.
  """
  @spec processing_state(Document.t()) :: processing_state()
  def processing_state(%Document{} = document) do
    latest = ExtractedContentContext.get_latest_by_document(document.id)
    classify_state(live_job?(document.id), latest)
  end

  @doc """
  Returns the processing state of many documents at once.

  Same semantics as `processing_state/1`, but resolved with two queries
  (live jobs and latest extraction per document) regardless of how many ids are
  given. Use it wherever a list of documents needs their current state.
  """
  @spec processing_states([pos_integer()]) :: %{pos_integer() => processing_state()}
  def processing_states([]), do: %{}

  def processing_states(document_ids) when is_list(document_ids) do
    live_ids =
      live_jobs()
      |> where(
        [j],
        fragment("?->>'document_id'", j.args) in ^Enum.map(document_ids, &to_string/1)
      )
      |> select([j], fragment("?->>'document_id'", j.args))
      |> Repo.all()
      |> MapSet.new()

    latest_statuses =
      ExtractedContent
      |> where([ec], ec.document_id in ^document_ids)
      |> distinct([ec], ec.document_id)
      |> order_by([ec], asc: ec.document_id, desc: ec.inserted_at, desc: ec.id)
      |> select([ec], {ec.document_id, ec.status})
      |> Repo.all()
      |> Map.new()

    Map.new(document_ids, fn id ->
      latest = latest_statuses[id] && %{status: latest_statuses[id]}
      {id, classify_state(MapSet.member?(live_ids, to_string(id)), latest)}
    end)
  end

  defp classify_state(true, _latest), do: :processing
  defp classify_state(false, nil), do: :stuck
  defp classify_state(false, %{status: "failed"}), do: :failed
  defp classify_state(false, %{status: "success"}), do: :extracted

  @doc """
  Retries processing for a document whose latest run failed or stalled.

  The document must be a persisted struct obtained through a scoped getter
  (e.g. `ZaimuTomo.Documents.get_document!/2`), matching the trust model of
  `ZaimuTomo.Documents.update_document/3`.
  Scope-checked: a document owned by another user returns `{:error, :not_found}`.
  Only `:failed` and `:stuck` are retryable; any other state returns
  `{:error, {:not_retryable, state}}`. The enqueue carries the latest extraction
  id as `supersedes_extraction_id` (nil when stuck), and failed rows are kept as
  history — the new run appends a row. An Oban uniqueness conflict counts as
  success: at most one live job can exist per document.
  """
  @spec retry_document(Scope.t(), Document.t()) ::
          {:ok, Oban.Job.t()} | {:error, :not_found | {:not_retryable, processing_state()}}
  def retry_document(%Scope{user: %{id: user_id}} = scope, %Document{user_id: user_id} = document) do
    latest = ExtractedContentContext.get_latest_by_document(document.id)

    case classify_state(live_job?(document.id), latest) do
      state when state in [:failed, :stuck] ->
        with {:ok, job} <-
               document
               |> ocr_job(scope.user.base_currency, latest && latest.id)
               |> Oban.insert() do
          # Lets open Index / hero views pick up the new live run without a reload.
          broadcast_event(:retried, user_id, %{document_id: document.id, user_id: user_id})
          {:ok, job}
        end

      state ->
        {:error, {:not_retryable, state}}
    end
  end

  def retry_document(%Scope{}, %Document{}), do: {:error, :not_found}

  @doc """
  Returns true when a live OCR job exists for the document.
  """
  @spec live_job?(pos_integer()) :: boolean()
  def live_job?(document_id) do
    # Same safe text comparison as Recovery.list_stuck/0: no ::bigint cast on
    # job args, so a malformed job (missing or non-numeric document_id) is
    # simply not a match and never raises.
    live_jobs()
    |> where([j], fragment("?->>'document_id' = ?", j.args, ^to_string(document_id)))
    |> limit(1)
    |> Repo.one()
    |> case do
      %Oban.Job{} -> true
      nil -> false
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Base query over live OCR jobs (worker + states that still count as in-flight).
  """
  @spec live_jobs() :: Ecto.Query.t()
  def live_jobs do
    from j in Oban.Job,
      where: j.worker == @ocr_job_worker,
      where: j.state in @live_job_states
  end
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ErrorClassification do
  @moduledoc """
  Pure classification of document-processing failure reasons by retryability.

  The OCR pipeline emits a variety of error shapes (storage, HTTP clients, LLM
  wrappers, prompt fetch, persistence). `classify/1` maps each to:

    * `:transient` — worth retrying (rate limits, outages, network/fs blips).
      The job returns `{:error, reason}` WITHOUT persisting; Oban backs off and
      retries, and persists a single failed row only on the final attempt.

    * `:permanent` — retrying cannot help (bad request, missing config, invalid
      payload, missing bytes). The job persists one failed row and completes.

  Classification is pattern-matched on the exact shapes the pipeline emits (see
  `ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.Worker.run/1`). It fails closed to `:permanent`
  for unrecognized non-atom shapes so a new bug never silently multiplies
  retries. Bare atoms are fail-closed too: only the explicitly listed
  POSIX/filesystem atoms below are `:transient`; every other atom is
  `:permanent`.

  `summarize/1` renders a bounded, body-free error class for Oban error
  history and logs, so raw provider response bodies never reach `oban_jobs`.
  """

  @type class :: :transient | :permanent

  # Storage / OCR / prompt: 408, 429 and 5xx are transient (rate limit/outage).
  @transient_statuses [408, 429]
  # The extractor LLM additionally treats 409/425 as transient (provider busy).
  @transient_llm_statuses [408, 409, 425, 429]
  @transient_status_max 500

  # Filesystem/transport atoms worth retrying (disk full, I/O blips, fs
  # pressure, network resets). Every other bare atom is permanent.
  @transient_posix [
    :enospc,
    :eio,
    :eagain,
    :ebusy,
    :etimedout,
    :econnrefused,
    :econnreset,
    :ehostunreach,
    :enetunreach,
    :emfile,
    :enfile
  ]

  # Bare atoms emitted by the OCR, prompt, extractor and verifier stages (not
  # storage), all permanent.
  @pipeline_atoms [
    :unexpected_api_structure,
    :missing_structured_output,
    :invalid_extraction_payload,
    :langfuse_prompt_api_not_configured,
    :invalid_langfuse_prompt_response,
    :prompt_fetcher_failed
  ]

  @doc """
  Classify a processing failure `reason` as `:transient` or `:permanent`.
  """
  @spec classify(term()) :: class()

  # -- Scratch / temporary file ------------------------------------------
  # Disk full or a tmp blip: retry.
  def classify({:scratch_unavailable, _posix}), do: :transient

  # -- Storage (S3 / memory) --------------------------------------------
  # Store overloaded or down (408/429/5xx).
  def classify({:unexpected_status, status}) when status in @transient_statuses,
    do: :transient

  def classify({:unexpected_status, status}) when status >= @transient_status_max,
    do: :transient

  # e.g. 403 signature/config, 400 bad request.
  def classify({:unexpected_status, _status}), do: :permanent

  # -- Prompt fetch (Langfuse) ------------------------------------------
  # Langfuse blip: a rate-limit/outage status or a transport error.
  def classify({:prompt_fetch_failed, status})
      when is_integer(status) and
             (status in @transient_statuses or status >= @transient_status_max),
      do: :transient

  def classify({:prompt_fetch_failed, %Req.TransportError{}}), do: :transient
  # Any other prompt failure (config, bad key, malformed prompt) is permanent.
  def classify({:prompt_fetch_failed, _other}), do: :permanent
  def classify({:local_prompt_not_found, _name}), do: :permanent

  # -- Extractor LLM ----------------------------------------------------
  # No status means a transport error.
  def classify({:llm_request_failed, %{status: nil}}), do: :transient

  # Provider / FLM busy.
  def classify({:llm_request_failed, %{status: status}})
      when status in @transient_llm_statuses or status >= @transient_status_max,
      do: :transient

  # 400 / 401 / 404 and other non-retryable statuses.
  def classify({:llm_request_failed, %{status: _status}}), do: :permanent
  def classify({:validation_failed, _errors}), do: :permanent

  # -- Mistral OCR ------------------------------------------------------
  # Local read of a just-written temp file failing (a bare posix atom) is a bug,
  # not a blip. HTTP/upload failures carry an {:http_status, ...} or transport
  # detail and are handled by the stage-tagged clauses below.
  def classify({:ocr_upload_failed, posix}) when is_atom(posix), do: :permanent

  # -- Persistence ------------------------------------------------------
  def classify({:persistence_failed, _errors}), do: :permanent

  # -- Mistral OCR (stage-tagged detail) --------------------------------
  # Rate limit / outage.
  def classify({_stage, {:http_status, status, _body}})
      when status in @transient_statuses or status >= @transient_status_max,
      do: :transient

  # Other 4xx: bad request / auth.
  def classify({_stage, {:http_status, _status, _body}}), do: :permanent
  # Timeout / connection refused.
  def classify({_stage, %Req.TransportError{}}), do: :transient
  # Missing config; needs a deploy, not a retry.
  def classify({_stage, "Missing Mistral API key"}), do: :permanent

  # -- Known permanent bare atoms --------------------------------------
  # The stored bytes are gone; a retry cannot help.
  def classify(:not_found), do: :permanent
  # OCR / prompt / extractor / verifier outcomes (unexpected body shape,
  # missing or invalid output, prompt config).
  def classify(reason) when reason in @pipeline_atoms, do: :permanent

  # -- Storage transport (bare posix / transport) ----------------------
  # Only the explicitly listed filesystem/transport atoms are retried; every
  # other bare atom (a new business/pseudo-error) is fail-closed to permanent.
  def classify(%Req.TransportError{}), do: :transient

  def classify(reason) when reason in @transient_posix, do: :transient
  def classify(reason) when is_atom(reason), do: :permanent

  # Fail closed: any unrecognized non-atom shape is permanent so a new bug never
  # silently multiplies retries.
  def classify(_other), do: :permanent

  @doc """
  Renders a bounded, body-free summary of a processing failure `reason`.

  Provider response bodies and other free-form payloads are never included, so
  the result is safe to persist in `oban_jobs.errors` and to log. Unknown
  shapes summarize to `"unclassified"`.
  """
  @spec summarize(term()) :: String.t()

  def summarize({stage, {:http_status, status, _body}})
      when is_atom(stage) and is_integer(status),
      do: "#{stage}:http_#{status}"

  def summarize({stage, %Req.TransportError{reason: reason}})
      when is_atom(stage) and is_atom(reason),
      do: "#{stage}:transport_#{reason}"

  def summarize({stage, %Req.TransportError{}}) when is_atom(stage), do: "#{stage}:transport"

  def summarize({stage, "Missing Mistral API key"}) when is_atom(stage),
    do: "#{stage}:missing_api_key"

  def summarize({stage, posix}) when is_atom(stage) and is_atom(posix), do: "#{stage}:#{posix}"

  def summarize({:llm_request_failed, %{status: status}}) when is_integer(status),
    do: "llm_request_failed:http_#{status}"

  def summarize({:llm_request_failed, %{status: nil}}), do: "llm_request_failed:transport"

  def summarize({:prompt_fetch_failed, status}) when is_integer(status),
    do: "prompt_fetch_failed:http_#{status}"

  def summarize({:persistence_failed, _errors}), do: "persistence_failed"
  def summarize({:validation_failed, _errors}), do: "validation_failed"
  def summarize({:local_prompt_not_found, _name}), do: "local_prompt_not_found"

  def summarize(%Req.TransportError{reason: reason}) when is_atom(reason),
    do: "storage:transport_#{reason}"

  def summarize(%Req.TransportError{}), do: "storage:transport"
  def summarize(reason) when reason in @pipeline_atoms, do: Atom.to_string(reason)
  def summarize(reason) when is_atom(reason), do: "storage:#{reason}"
  def summarize(_other), do: "unclassified"
end

      ]
    },
    %{
      name: "Pillar 3a",
      account_type: :investment,
      currency: "CHF",
      bank_name: "VIAC",
      account_number: "3a-004281",
      source: :bank_sync,

        {4, 8_510_000},
        {3, 8_650_000},
        {1, 8_780_000},
        {0, 8_940_000}
      ]
    }

  def seed! do
    user = ensure_demo_user!()
    scope = Scope.for_user(user)

    accounts = Enum.map(@accounts, &ensure_account!(scope, &1))

    %{user: user, accounts: accounts}
  end

    case Accounts.get_user_by_email(@demo_email) do

        {:ok, {user, _expired_tokens}} =
          Accounts.update_user_password(user, %{password: @demo_password})

        user

      user ->
        user
    end
  end

  defp ensure_account!(scope, attrs) do
    balance_history = balance_history(attrs, Date.utc_today())

    account =
      case Repo.get_by(FinancialAccount, user_id: scope.user.id, name: attrs.name) do
        nil ->
          [initial_snapshot | _] = balance_history

          {:ok, %{account: account}} =
            FinancialAccounts.create_financial_account_with_balance(
              scope,
              Map.take(attrs, [
                :name,
                :account_type,
                :currency,
                :bank_name,
                :account_number,
                :source
              ]),
              initial_snapshot
            )

          account

        account ->
          account
      end

    ensure_balance_history!(scope, account, balance_history)

    %{
      account: account,
      balance_snapshot: scope |> FinancialAccounts.list_balance_snapshots(account) |> hd()
    }
  end

  defp balance_history(attrs, today) do
    Enum.map(attrs.balance_history, fn {months_ago, amount_cents} ->
      %{amount_cents: amount_cents, recorded_on: Date.shift(today, month: -months_ago)}
    end)
  end

  defp ensure_balance_history!(scope, account, balance_history) do
    recorded_on_dates =
      scope
      |> FinancialAccounts.list_balance_snapshots(account)
      |> MapSet.new(& &1.recorded_on)

    Enum.each(balance_history, fn snapshot ->
      unless MapSet.member?(recorded_on_dates, snapshot.recorded_on) do
        {:ok, _snapshot} = FinancialAccounts.record_balance(scope, account, snapshot)
      end
    end)
  end
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document do
  use Ecto.Schema
  import Ecto.Changeset

  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Fingerprint

  schema "documents" do
    field :filename, :string
    field :object_key, :string
    # Fingerprint of the bytes at `object_key`; nil for legacy rows until the
    # backfill reads them. Redacted so it never reaches logs.
    field :content_sha256, :string, redact: true
    field :user_id, :id

    has_many :extracted_content, ExtractedContent

    timestamps(type: :utc_datetime)
  end

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{}

  @doc false
  def changeset(document, attrs, user_scope) do
    document
    |> cast(attrs, [:filename, :object_key, :content_sha256])
    |> validate_required([:filename, :object_key])
    |> validate_format(:content_sha256, Fingerprint.format())
    |> clear_stale_fingerprint()
    |> put_change(:user_id, user_scope.user.id)
    |> foreign_key_constraint(:user_id)
  end

  # The digest describes the bytes at `object_key`. Replacing the object
  # without a new digest must not leave the old file's digest behind.
  defp clear_stale_fingerprint(changeset) do
    if changed?(changeset, :object_key) and not changed?(changeset, :content_sha256) do
      put_change(changeset, :content_sha256, nil)
    else
      changeset
    end
  end
end

defmodule ZaimuTomo.Accounting.JournalEntry do
  use Ecto.Schema
  import Ecto.Changeset

  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounting.TaxDeductionClaim
  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.User
  alias ZaimuTomo.Currency
  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Fingerprint
  alias ZaimuTomo.Review.ReviewDecision

  @need_or_want_values ["need", "want"]
  @duplicate_invoice_index "journal_entries_user_issuer_number_unique_index"
  @duplicate_source_file_index "journal_entries_user_source_document_sha256_unique_index"

  @typedoc "Journal entry schema struct"
  @type t :: %__MODULE__{
          __meta__: Ecto.Schema.Metadata.t(),
          id: integer() | nil,
          amount_cents: integer() | nil,
          currency: String.t() | nil,
          date: Date.t() | nil,
          description: String.t() | nil,
          issuer: String.t() | nil,
          invoice_number: String.t() | nil,
          category: String.t() | nil,
          need_or_want: String.t() | nil,
          status: String.t() | nil,
          notes: String.t() | nil,
          source_document_sha256: String.t() | nil,
          source_file_reuse_confirmed: boolean(),
          review_decision_id: integer() | nil,
          user_id: integer() | nil,
          review_decision: Ecto.Schema.belongs_to(struct()),
          user: Ecto.Schema.belongs_to(struct()),
          tax_deduction_claim: Ecto.Schema.has_one(TaxDeductionClaim.t()),
          inserted_at: DateTime.t() | nil,
          updated_at: DateTime.t() | nil
        }

  schema "journal_entries" do
    field :amount_cents, :integer
    field :currency, :string
    field :date, :date
    field :description, :string
    field :issuer, :string
    field :invoice_number, :string
    field :category, :string
    field :need_or_want, :string
    field :status, :string
    field :notes, :string
    # Posting-time snapshot of the source document's fingerprint. Only the
    # one-off backfill may set it on an existing row (see the backfill module).
    field :source_document_sha256, :string, redact: true
    field :source_file_reuse_confirmed, :boolean, default: false

    belongs_to :review_decision, ReviewDecision
    belongs_to :user, User
    has_one :tax_deduction_claim, TaxDeductionClaim

    timestamps(type: :utc_datetime)
  end

  @spec changeset_for_create(map()) :: Ecto.Changeset.t(t())
  def changeset_for_create(attrs) do
    %__MODULE__{}
    |> cast(attrs, [
      :review_decision_id,
      :user_id,
      :amount_cents,
      :currency,
      :date,
      :description,
      :issuer,
      :invoice_number,
      :status,
      :source_document_sha256,
      :source_file_reuse_confirmed
    ])
    |> Currency.normalize_and_validate(:currency)
    |> validate_required([:review_decision_id, :user_id, :amount_cents, :currency, :date])
    |> validate_inclusion(:status, ["uncategorized", "posted"])
    |> foreign_key_constraint(:review_decision_id)
    |> foreign_key_constraint(:user_id)
    |> unique_constraint(:review_decision_id)
    |> fingerprint_constraints()
    |> unique_constraint(:invoice_number,
      name: @duplicate_invoice_index,
      message: "has already been recorded for this issuer"
    )
  end

  @doc """
  Changeset for the historical fingerprint backfill: the only permitted update
  of `source_document_sha256` (and, for a human-resolved collision,
  `source_file_reuse_confirmed`) on an existing entry.
  """
  @spec changeset_for_fingerprint_backfill(t(), map()) :: Ecto.Changeset.t(t())
  def changeset_for_fingerprint_backfill(%__MODULE__{} = entry, attrs) do
    entry
    |> cast(attrs, [:source_document_sha256, :source_file_reuse_confirmed])
    |> validate_required([:source_document_sha256])
    |> fingerprint_constraints()
  end

  defp fingerprint_constraints(changeset) do
    changeset
    |> validate_format(:source_document_sha256, Fingerprint.format())
    |> unique_constraint(:source_document_sha256,
      name: @duplicate_source_file_index,
      message: "the same file has already been recorded"
    )
  end

  @doc "Name of the unique (user, issuer, invoice number) index."
  @spec duplicate_invoice_index() :: String.t()
  def duplicate_invoice_index, do: @duplicate_invoice_index

  @doc "Name of the unique (user, source file digest) index over unconfirmed postings."
  @spec duplicate_source_file_index() :: String.t()
  def duplicate_source_file_index, do: @duplicate_source_file_index

  @spec changeset_for_categorize(t(), map()) :: Ecto.Changeset.t(t())
  def changeset_for_categorize(%__MODULE__{} = entry, attrs) do
    entry
    |> cast(attrs, [:category, :need_or_want, :notes, :status])
    |> validate_required([:category, :need_or_want])
    |> validate_inclusion(:need_or_want, @need_or_want_values)
    |> validate_inclusion(:status, ["uncategorized", "posted"])
    |> check_constraint(:need_or_want, name: :journal_entries_need_or_want_check)
  end

  @spec need_or_want_values() :: [String.t()]
  def need_or_want_values, do: @need_or_want_values
end

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  The DocumentProcessing context.
4	
5	  Builds durable OCR job commands that Oban dispatches. The enqueue is atomic
6	  with the document insert (see `ZaimuTomo.Documents.create_document/2`), so an
7	  upload can never exist without its processing job.
8	
9	  Also owns the processing state of a document and the scope-checked retry
10	  entry point for failed or stuck runs.
11	  """
12	
13	  import Ecto.Query
14	
15	  alias ZaimuTomo.Accounts.Scope
16	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContent.ExtractedContent
17	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ExtractedContentContext
18	  alias ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.OCRJob
19	  alias ZaimuTomo.Documents.Document
20	  alias ZaimuTomo.Repo
21	
22	  @ocr_job_worker "ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.OCRJob"
23	  @live_job_states ~w(available scheduled executing retryable)
24	  @event_kinds [:success, :failed, :retried]
25	
26	  @typedoc """
27	  Processing state of a document:
28	
29	    * `:processing` — a live OCR job exists (queued, scheduled or running)
30	    * `:stuck` — no extraction and no live job (the run was lost)
31	    * `:failed` — the latest extraction failed
32	    * `:extracted` — the latest extraction succeeded
33	  """
34	  @type processing_state :: :processing | :stuck | :failed | :extracted
35	
36	  @doc """
37	  Subscribes the caller to the scope owner's processing events.
38	
39	  Messages are the maps broadcast by `broadcast_event/3`: a run finished
40	  (`:success` / `:failed`) or a retry was enqueued (`:retried`). Topics are per
41	  owner, so a subscriber never receives another user's extracted data.
42	  """
43	  @spec subscribe_events(Scope.t()) :: :ok | {:error, term()}
44	  def subscribe_events(%Scope{user: %{id: user_id}}) do
45	    Enum.find_value(@event_kinds, :ok, fn kind ->
46	      case Phoenix.PubSub.subscribe(ZaimuTomo.PubSub, event_topic(user_id, kind)) do
47	        :ok -> nil
48	        error -> error
49	      end
50	    end)
51	  end
52	
53	  @doc false
54	  @spec broadcast_event(:success | :failed | :retried, integer(), map()) ::
55	          :ok | {:error, term()}
56	  def broadcast_event(kind, user_id, payload) when kind in @event_kinds do
57	    Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast(ZaimuTomo.PubSub, event_topic(user_id, kind), payload)
58	  end
59	
60	  defp event_topic(user_id, kind), do: "user:#{user_id}:document_processing:#{kind}"
61	
62	  @doc """
63	  Builds the OCR job changeset for a document.
64	
65	  The command is self-contained and resolved at enqueue time: the document id,
66	  a queue-time snapshot of the owner's base currency (`currency_hint`), and the
67	  latest extraction id to supersede (or `nil` when there is none). The worker
68	  pattern-matches this command and never queries Accounts.
69	  """
70	  def ocr_job(%Document{} = document, currency_hint, supersedes_extraction_id) do
71	    OCRJob.new(%{
72	      document_id: document.id,
73	      currency_hint: currency_hint,
74	      supersedes_extraction_id: supersedes_extraction_id
75	    })
76	  end
77	
78	  @doc """
79	  Returns the processing state of a document.
80	  """
81	  @spec processing_state(Document.t()) :: processing_state()
82	  def processing_state(%Document{} = document) do
83	    latest = ExtractedContentContext.get_latest_by_document(document.id)
84	    classify_state(live_job?(document.id), latest)
85	  end
86	
87	  @doc """
88	  Returns the processing state of many documents at once.
89	
90	  Same semantics as `processing_state/1`, but resolved with two queries
91	  (live jobs and latest extraction per document) regardless of how many ids are
92	  given. Use it wherever a list of documents needs their current state.
93	  """
94	  @spec processing_states([pos_integer()]) :: %{pos_integer() => processing_state()}
95	  def processing_states([]), do: %{}
96	
97	  def processing_states(document_ids) when is_list(document_ids) do
98	    live_ids =
99	      live_jobs()
100	      |> where(
101	        [j],
102	        fragment("?->>'document_id'", j.args) in ^Enum.map(document_ids, &to_string/1)
103	      )
104	      |> select([j], fragment("?->>'document_id'", j.args))
105	      |> Repo.all()
106	      |> MapSet.new()
107	
108	    latest_statuses =
109	      ExtractedContent
110	      |> where([ec], ec.document_id in ^document_ids)
111	      |> distinct([ec], ec.document_id)
112	      |> order_by([ec], asc: ec.document_id, desc: ec.inserted_at, desc: ec.id)
113	      |> select([ec], {ec.document_id, ec.status})
114	      |> Repo.all()
115	      |> Map.new()
116	
117	    Map.new(document_ids, fn id ->
118	      latest = latest_statuses[id] && %{status: latest_statuses[id]}
119	      {id, classify_state(MapSet.member?(live_ids, to_string(id)), latest)}
120	    end)
121	  end
122	
123	  defp classify_state(true, _latest), do: :processing
124	  defp classify_state(false, nil), do: :stuck
125	  defp classify_state(false, %{status: "failed"}), do: :failed
126	  defp classify_state(false, %{status: "success"}), do: :extracted
127	
128	  @doc """
129	  Retries processing for a document whose latest run failed or stalled.
130	
131	  The document must be a persisted struct obtained through a scoped getter
132	  (e.g. `ZaimuTomo.Documents.get_document!/2`), matching the trust model of
133	  `ZaimuTomo.Documents.update_document/3`.
134	  Scope-checked: a document owned by another user returns `{:error, :not_found}`.
135	  Only `:failed` and `:stuck` are retryable; any other state returns
136	  `{:error, {:not_retryable, state}}`. The enqueue carries the latest extraction
137	  id as `supersedes_extraction_id` (nil when stuck), and failed rows are kept as
138	  history — the new run appends a row. An Oban uniqueness conflict counts as
139	  success: at most one live job can exist per document.
140	  """
141	  @spec retry_document(Scope.t(), Document.t()) ::
142	          {:ok, Oban.Job.t()} | {:error, :not_found | {:not_retryable, processing_state()}}
143	  def retry_document(%Scope{user: %{id: user_id}} = scope, %Document{user_id: user_id} = document) do
144	    latest = ExtractedContentContext.get_latest_by_document(document.id)
145	
146	    case classify_state(live_job?(document.id), latest) do
147	      state when state in [:failed, :stuck] ->
148	        with {:ok, job} <-
149	               document
150	               |> ocr_job(scope.user.base_currency, latest && latest.id)
151	               |> Oban.insert() do
152	          # Lets open Index / hero views pick up the new live run without a reload.
153	          broadcast_event(:retried, user_id, %{document_id: document.id, user_id: user_id})
154	          {:ok, job}
155	        end
156	
157	      state ->
158	        {:error, {:not_retryable, state}}
159	    end
160	  end
161	
162	  def retry_document(%Scope{}, %Document{}), do: {:error, :not_found}
163	
164	  @doc """
165	  Returns true when a live OCR job exists for the document.
166	  """
167	  @spec live_job?(pos_integer()) :: boolean()
168	  def live_job?(document_id) do
169	    # Same safe text comparison as Recovery.list_stuck/0: no ::bigint cast on
170	    # job args, so a malformed job (missing or non-numeric document_id) is
171	    # simply not a match and never raises.
172	    live_jobs()
173	    |> where([j], fragment("?->>'document_id' = ?", j.args, ^to_string(document_id)))
174	    |> limit(1)
175	    |> Repo.one()
176	    |> case do
177	      %Oban.Job{} -> true
178	      nil -> false
179	    end
180	  end
181	
182	  @doc """
183	  Base query over live OCR jobs (worker + states that still count as in-flight).
184	  """
185	  @spec live_jobs() :: Ecto.Query.t()
186	  def live_jobs do
187	    from j in Oban.Job,
188	      where: j.worker == @ocr_job_worker,
189	      where: j.state in @live_job_states
190	  end
191	end
192

1	defmodule ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.ErrorClassification do
2	  @moduledoc """
3	  Pure classification of document-processing failure reasons by retryability.
4	
5	  The OCR pipeline emits a variety of error shapes (storage, HTTP clients, LLM
6	  wrappers, prompt fetch, persistence). `classify/1` maps each to:
7	
8	    * `:transient` — worth retrying (rate limits, outages, network/fs blips).
9	      The job returns `{:error, reason}` WITHOUT persisting; Oban backs off and
10	      retries, and persists a single failed row only on the final attempt.
11	
12	    * `:permanent` — retrying cannot help (bad request, missing config, invalid
13	      payload, missing bytes). The job persists one failed row and completes.
14	
15	  Classification is pattern-matched on the exact shapes the pipeline emits (see
16	  `ZaimuTomo.DocumentProcessing.Worker.run/1`). It fails closed to `:permanent`
17	  for unrecognized non-atom shapes so a new bug never silently multiplies
18	  retries. Bare atoms are fail-closed too: only the explicitly listed
19	  POSIX/filesystem atoms below are `:transient`; every other atom is
20	  `:permanent`.
21	
22	  `summarize/1` renders a bounded, body-free error class for Oban error
23	  history and logs, so raw provider response bodies never reach `oban_jobs`.
24	  """
25	
26	  @type class :: :transient | :permanent
27	
28	  # Storage / OCR / prompt: 408, 429 and 5xx are transient (rate limit/outage).
29	  @transient_statuses [408, 429]
30	  # The extractor LLM additionally treats 409/425 as transient (provider busy).
31	  @transient_llm_statuses [408, 409, 425, 429]
32	  @transient_status_max 500
33	
34	  # Filesystem/transport atoms worth retrying (disk full, I/O blips, fs
35	  # pressure, network resets). Every other bare atom is permanent.
36	  @transient_posix [
37	    :enospc,
38	    :eio,
39	    :eagain,
40	    :ebusy,
41	    :etimedout,
42	    :econnrefused,
43	    :econnreset,
44	    :ehostunreach,
45	    :enetunreach,
46	    :emfile,
47	    :enfile
48	  ]
49	
50	  # Bare atoms emitted by the OCR, prompt, extractor and verifier stages (not
51	  # storage), all permanent.
52	  @pipeline_atoms [
53	    :unexpected_api_structure,
54	    :missing_structured_output,
55	    :invalid_extraction_payload,
56	    :langfuse_prompt_api_not_configured,
57	    :invalid_langfuse_prompt_response,
58	    :prompt_fetcher_failed
59	  ]
60	
61	  @doc """
62	  Classify a processing failure `reason` as `:transient` or `:permanent`.
63	  """
64	  @spec classify(term()) :: class()
65	
66	  # -- Scratch / temporary file ------------------------------------------
67	  # Disk full or a tmp blip: retry.
68	  def classify({:scratch_unavailable, _posix}), do: :transient
69	
70	  # -- Storage (S3 / memory) --------------------------------------------
71	  # Store overloaded or down (408/429/5xx).
72	  def classify({:unexpected_status, status}) when status in @transient_statuses,
73	    do: :transient
74	
75	  def classify({:unexpected_status, status}) when status >= @transient_status_max,
76	    do: :transient
77	
78	  # e.g. 403 signature/config, 400 bad request.
79	  def classify({:unexpected_status, _status}), do: :permanent
80	
81	  # -- Prompt fetch (Langfuse) ------------------------------------------
82	  # Langfuse blip: a rate-limit/outage status or a transport error.
83	  def classify({:prompt_fetch_failed, status})
84	      when is_integer(status) and
85	             (status in @transient_statuses or status >= @transient_status_max),
86	      do: :transient
87	
88	  def classify({:prompt_fetch_failed, %Req.TransportError{}}), do: :transient
89	  # Any other prompt failure (config, bad key, malformed prompt) is permanent.
90	  def classify({:prompt_fetch_failed, _other}), do: :permanent
91	  def classify({:local_prompt_not_found, _name}), do: :permanent
92	
93	  # -- Extractor LLM ----------------------------------------------------
94	  # No status means a transport error.
95	  def classify({:llm_request_failed, %{status: nil}}), do: :transient
96	
97	  # Provider / FLM busy.
98	  def classify({:llm_request_failed, %{status: status}})
99	      when status in @transient_llm_statuses or status >= @transient_status_max,
100	      do: :transient
101	
102	  # 400 / 401 / 404 and other non-retryable statuses.
103	  def classify({:llm_request_failed, %{status: _status}}), do: :permanent
104	  def classify({:validation_failed, _errors}), do: :permanent
105	
106	  # -- Mistral OCR ------------------------------------------------------
107	  # Local read of a just-written temp file failing (a bare posix atom) is a bug,
108	  # not a blip. HTTP/upload failures carry an {:http_status, ...} or transport
109	  # detail and are handled by the stage-tagged clauses below.
110	  def classify({:ocr_upload_failed, posix}) when is_atom(posix), do: :permanent
111	
112	  # -- Persistence ------------------------------------------------------
113	  def classify({:persistence_failed, _errors}), do: :permanent
114	
115	  # -- Mistral OCR (stage-tagged detail) --------------------------------
116	  # Rate limit / outage.
117	  def classify({_stage, {:http_status, status, _body}})
118	      when status in @transient_statuses or status >= @transient_status_max,
119	      do: :transient
120	
121	  # Other 4xx: bad request / auth.
122	  def classify({_stage, {:http_status, _status, _body}}), do: :permanent
123	  # Timeout / connection refused.
124	  def classify({_stage, %Req.TransportError{}}), do: :transient
125	  # Missing config; needs a deploy, not a retry.
126	  def classify({_stage, "Missing Mistral API key"}), do: :permanent
127	
128	  # -- Known permanent bare atoms --------------------------------------
129	  # The stored bytes are gone; a retry cannot help.
130	  def classify(:not_found), do: :permanent
131	  # OCR / prompt / extractor / verifier outcomes (unexpected body shape,
132	  # missing or invalid output, prompt config).
133	  def classify(reason) when reason in @pipeline_atoms, do: :permanent
134	
135	  # -- Storage transport (bare posix / transport) ----------------------
136	  # Only the explicitly listed filesystem/transport atoms are retried; every
137	  # other bare atom (a new business/pseudo-error) is fail-closed to permanent.
138	  def classify(%Req.TransportError{}), do: :transient
139	
140	  def classify(reason) when reason in @transient_posix, do: :transient
141	  def classify(reason) when is_atom(reason), do: :permanent
142	
143	  # Fail closed: any unrecognized non-atom shape is permanent so a new bug never
144	  # silently multiplies retries.
145	  def classify(_other), do: :permanent
146	
147	  @doc """
148	  Renders a bounded, body-free summary of a processing failure `reason`.
149	
150	  Provider response bodies and other free-form payloads are never included, so
151	  the result is safe to persist in `oban_jobs.errors` and to log. Unknown
152	  shapes summarize to `"unclassified"`.
153	  """
154	  @spec summarize(term()) :: String.t()
155	
156	  def summarize({stage, {:http_status, status, _body}})
157	      when is_atom(stage) and is_integer(status),
158	      do: "#{stage}:http_#{status}"
159	
160	  def summarize({stage, %Req.TransportError{reason: reason}})
161	      when is_atom(stage) and is_atom(reason),
162	      do: "#{stage}:transport_#{reason}"
163	
164	  def summarize({stage, %Req.TransportError{}}) when is_atom(stage), do: "#{stage}:transport"
165	
166	  def summarize({stage, "Missing Mistral API key"}) when is_atom(stage),
167	    do: "#{stage}:missing_api_key"
168	
169	  def summarize({stage, posix}) when is_atom(stage) and is_atom(posix), do: "#{stage}:#{posix}"
170	
171	  def summarize({:llm_request_failed, %{status: status}}) when is_integer(status),
172	    do: "llm_request_failed:http_#{status}"
173	
174	  def summarize({:llm_request_failed, %{status: nil}}), do: "llm_request_failed:transport"
175	
176	  def summarize({:prompt_fetch_failed, status}) when is_integer(status),
177	    do: "prompt_fetch_failed:http_#{status}"
178	
179	  def summarize({:persistence_failed, _errors}), do: "persistence_failed"
180	  def summarize({:validation_failed, _errors}), do: "validation_failed"
181	  def summarize({:local_prompt_not_found, _name}), do: "local_prompt_not_found"
182	
183	  def summarize(%Req.TransportError{reason: reason}) when is_atom(reason),
184	    do: "storage:transport_#{reason}"
185	
186	  def summarize(%Req.TransportError{}), do: "storage:transport"
187	  def summarize(reason) when reason in @pipeline_atoms, do: Atom.to_string(reason)
188	  def summarize(reason) when is_atom(reason), do: "storage:#{reason}"
189	  def summarize(_other), do: "unclassified"
190	end

11	    # Fingerprint of the bytes at `object_key`; nil for legacy rows until the
